🔥🇲🇽 <u>THE BOT FARMS WAGING WAR ON THE 4T</u>

As Sheinbaum denounces bot farms manufacturing fake trending topics to brand her government a "narco-state," Mexican philosopher Fernando Buen Abad dissects the machinery in Contralínea: bot farms are "an industrial form of manufacturing" consensus, engineering the illusion of unanimous opinion to reshape what people believe others believe. The weapon isn't any single lie — it's control over what stays visible.
banner: BOT FARMS VS THE 4T: FAKE CONSENSUS

🚨🇲🇽 <u>4T INTELLIGENCE, NOT WAR, TAKES DOWN 'KOKI'</u>

A joint operation — SSPC, Defensa, Marina, the National Guard and the CNI intelligence center with Tabasco and Hidalgo — captured Jorge Luis "Koki" de la Cruz León, a priority target and alleged boss of "Pueblo Unido," on the Mexico–Pachuca highway. No shootout, no spectacle: intelligence-led policing, the opposite of the old kingpin bloodbaths. He is accused of extortion, kidnapping, human trafficking and torching vehicles across Tabasco.

🇲🇽📱 <u>MEXICO LINKS 14.7M SIMS TO CHOKE EXTORTION</u>

Mexico's telecom regulator (CRT) reactivated 3,627,213 mobile lines between Aug 16–25 once users tied them to their CURP national ID — part of a 14.7-million-line registry, now 65.8% linked, built to strip the anonymity behind extortion and fraud calls. Some 2.5 million dead lines will be purged. La Jornada reports the CRT expects another 2.6 million reactivations in the coming days.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO NEGOTIATES, IT DOESN'T KNEEL</u>

In Washington, Marco Rubio "demanded decisive action" on fentanyl, migration and cartels — as Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco met him and Economy chief Ebrard worked to bring US tariffs down. Mexico came as a sovereign partner, not a subordinate: the official readout stressed "the protection and respect of the human rights of Mexican people in the US." No new operatives were announced, and Sheinbaum has already ruled out any foreign forces operating on Mexican soil.
banner: MEXICO HOLDS LINE ON RUBIO PRESSURE

text:
🇲🇽📈 <u>Banxico lifts Mexico's 2026 growth forecast to 1.5%</u>

The same central bank that slashed its outlook to 1.1% back in May just revised it up to 1.5% for 2026, pointing to a second quarter that expanded 1.4% — the strongest in years. It sees inflation closing the year near 3.5% and calls the recovery "moderada y gradual" — all of it under the tariffs Washington aimed straight at Mexico.

🇲🇽🚆 <u>The first 12 cargo locomotives of the Tren Maya have arrived</u>

The freight Tren Maya just took delivery of its first 12 locomotives, already hauling materials across a 1,500 km network that links five southeastern states, the port of Progreso, and the Interoceanic Corridor running between two oceans. Fuel, food, cement and containers — moving by rail through the region Mexico's elites spent decades writing off. Cargo service starts in 2027.

🇲🇽🌱 <u>Mexico rewrites its environmental law for the first time since 1988</u>

For 38 years the law governing Mexico's environment never once mentioned climate change — it was written before the people in power would admit it existed. Sheinbaum has sent Congress a new General Law on Ecological Protection and Environmental Justice: restoration programs, circular economy, protection for environmental defenders, and Indigenous knowledge placed beside science. "No podemos hacer ciencia sin reconocer la sabiduría que tienen nuestros pueblos indígenas," said Semarnat chief Alicia Bárcena.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum: Vicente Fox is a traitor to democracy</u>

Fox now claims he "saved" AMLO from the 2005 desafuero. Sheinbaum answered plainly: "Fox es un traidor a la democracia." Fox manufactured the charges to bar AMLO from the 2006 ballot, then backed the fraud that stole it — and what forced him to retreat wasn't mercy, it was more than a million people filling the streets. "La gente salió a la calle," she said. The man who lost that fight doesn't get to rewrite it.

🇲🇽⚛️ <u>Mexico will design and build a particle detector for CERN</u>

For the first time, a detector conceived and built by Mexican scientists is headed for ALICE, one of the four great experiments at CERN's Large Hadron Collider. UNAM physicist Antonio Ortiz leads the MID — a muon detector using scintillator bars and machine learning that beat better-funded labs on both cost and precision. Nine Mexican institutions are on it, with the first chambers to be manufactured in Mexico by 2028.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Sheinbaum won't fly to Trump until there's a deal on the table</u>

Washington has hit Mexico with 50% tariffs on steel and aluminum and 25% on cars — and Sheinbaum still isn't rushing north for a photo op. "Cuando lleguemos a un acuerdo ya podríamos reunirnos," she said this week: the meeting comes after an agreement, not before it. 21 phone calls with Trump, Ebrard parked in Washington negotiating, and no rush to the photo line.
banner: SHEINBAUM: NO TRUMP MEET WITHOUT A DEAL
